script_text: Aquarius, Air meets Uranus this week, triggering a seismic shift that rewrites your rhythm. Saturn conjunct Pluto weighs on your 11th House, demanding you release stagnant friendships. Monday and Tuesday suffer as Mercury squares Neptune, clouding communication. Wednesday breaks the fog when Mercury trine Jupiter activates your 3rd House, unlocking opportunities. By Wednesday evening, Venus enters your 5th House, redirecting your focus toward authentic romance and deep creative expression. Mars in Aries fires your 9th House Thursday through Saturday, fueling bold career moves. Sunday's Full Moon in Aquarius spotlights your 10th House for career recognition. Wednesday is your power day because Mercury trine Jupiter activates your 3rd House communication. Sunday is your worst day as the Full Moon amplifies career tension in your 10th House. Have an honest career talk before Thursday, because Saturn conjunct Pluto in your 11th House rewards decisive action. Follow for daily updates.
